svg.aria-label: Schematic of ArqueoGal as one red giant's path: its TESS light curve gives oscillations (task 2) and, with PARAM, mass and age (task 4); its Gaia astrometry gives an orbit (task 3, from Andreas Neitzel's kinematics code); its spectrum gives chemistry, from APOGEE for one star in ten and from his network JANUS for the rest (task 3). The three fill one row of the all-sky catalogue; his package Starfold returns the population (task 5); the Galactic model reads the catalogue and draws the disc (task 6). Stages he built are filled in the accent colour. A timeline carries the deliverables from February 2026 to August 2027, with task 1 and task 7 at its ends.

g.text: ONE RED GIANT, THROUGH THE PROJECT
tasks 1 and 7, data management and outreach, run alongside
FCT exploratory project 2024.15303.PEX, PI Campante, 18 months
